name: Lady Guildenstern
message: Say, Rosie... I've never looked at these portraits up close.

name: Lady Guildenstern
message: Queen Astrid was... beautiful, wasn't she?

name: Lady Guildenstern
message: I heard from my father she passed away, but... why did she die?

name: Lady Rosencrantz
message: Hamlet won't say. I think it was rather bloody.

name: Lady Rosencrantz
message: I know she died a raving lunatic.
